ValidationRule.description: Channel SID from Twilio must start with 'CH' and should have 34 characters in total.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(ISBLANK(Twilio_Channel_SID__c)), OR( NOT(BEGINS(Twilio_Channel_SID__c, 'CH')), NOT(LEN(Twilio_Channel_SID__c) = 34) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Channel SID must start with 'CH' and should have 34 characters in total.
